name: Shanghai QiFan Cable Co., Ltd
summary: Shanghai QiFan Cable Co., Ltd engages in the research, development, production, sales, and service of wires and cables in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company offers electric building wires; low, medium, and high voltage power cables; building cables; control cables; instrument cables; rubber cables; solar photovoltaic (PV) cables; and submarine power cables. Its products are used in power, home decoration, rail transit, construction engineering, new energy, communications, shipbuilding, intelligent equipment, metallurgy, petrochemicals, port machinery, marine engineering and mining, offshore wind power, and other fields.
